cfs.file_downloader.Definition

Describes the particular file inside the bucket for further downloading.

Available as lseg.data.delivery.cfs.file_downloader.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(file: dict | CFSFile)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
file dict | CFSFile Yes Dictionary or file object that contains the file ID and file name.

Methods

retrieve

Retrieves the FileDownloader object for further retrieval or extraction of files.

retrieve(session=None) -> FileDownloader

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session No None Session object. If it's not passed the default session will be used.

Returns

FileDownloader instance
